AgentExecutionRequest.description: Request is the complete, serializable input for one agent stage.

plugins.description:
Plugins are bundled Yaegi plugins from the skill's plugins/
directory. Each entry carries the name and source so the agent
can register them as tools. PRD section 5 Layer 1.

AgentExecutionResult.description: Result is the serializable outcome of one agent stage.

CaptureTool.description: CaptureTool declares a structured-output tool whose calls are returned to the daemon as data.

Command.description: Command is one executable gate or preflight command.

Gate.description: Gate is the quality gate an agent must satisfy.

MediaAttachment.description: MediaAttachment describes a file attached to a message.

duration.description: Duration is the play time in seconds for audio and video.

file_id.description: FileID is the platform-assigned identifier for download APIs.

file_name.description: FileName is the original file name when known.

file_size.description: FileSize is the attachment size in bytes. nil means unknown.

height.description: Height is the pixel height for images and video.

path.description:
Path is a local filesystem path on the host that produced the
attachment. It is the alternative to URL for outbound delivery: a
URL is fetched by the platform, a Path is uploaded by us. A file the
agent wrote has no URL and never gets one -- publishing it would
trade a delivery problem for a hosting and access-control one -- so
senders that support upload must read this.

Exactly one of URL and Path is meaningful for an outbound send.

url.description:
URL is a direct download URL when available. May be empty for
platforms that require a download API call.

width.description:
Width is the pixel width for images and video. nil means unknown
or not applicable.

MessageEvent.description: MessageEvent is the rich message model for all gateway channels.

callback_data.description:
CallbackData is the payload from a button or inline-keyboard
press (Type == MsgCallback).

channel_id.description:
ChannelID identifies the conversation within the platform
(chat ID, channel name, DM thread).

edited_from.description:
EditedFrom is the original text before the edit. Set only when
Type is MsgEdited.

id.description:
ID is the platform-assigned message identifier. Used for reply
threading, reactions, and edit/delete tracking.

media.description: Media holds attached files. Nil for text-only messages.

raw.description:
Raw is the original platform-specific payload. Adapters set
this for debug logging or handlers that need platform details
not captured by the generic fields.

reacted_to_id.description: ReactedToID is the message being reacted to.

reaction.description: Reaction is the emoji used when Type is MsgReaction.

reply_to_id.description:
ReplyToID is the platform message ID this message is in reply
to. Empty for top-level messages.

sender_id.description: SenderID is the platform-specific sender identifier.

sender_name.description: SenderName is the display name when available.

text.description:
Text is the human-readable message body. It carries the caption
for media messages and the full content for text and system
messages.

thread_id.description:
ThreadID identifies the conversation thread for platforms that
support threading (Slack, Discord forums).

timestamp.description:
Timestamp is the platform-assigned message time in Unix
milliseconds. Zero when unknown.

PluginSpec.description: PluginSpec is a bundled Yaegi plugin passed from daemon to agent.

Protection.description: Protection describes paths the agent may read but not mutate.

Usage.description: Usage preserves provider-reported token economics for evaluation.
